title: SmimeError string variants prevent programmatic error discrimination by callers
description: SmimeError::CertChain(String), MalformedInput(String), and Other(String) wrap messages as strings. Callers who need to distinguish 'certificate expired' from 'pathLen violated' from 'issuer signature mismatch' must parse the string — this is brittle and breaks when error messages change. Library callers (e.g. policy enforcement, audit logging) benefit from matching on structured variants. Since the crate is pre-1.0, now is the time to introduce structured sub-types (e.g. CertChainError::Expired, CertChainError::PathLen, CertChainError::SignatureMismatch). AllSignersFailed already demonstrates the right pattern for verify(). The maintenance consequence: once published and depended on, changing CertChain(String) to CertChain(CertChainError) is a breaking change.
